country_event = {
	id = zin_reign.34
	title = zin_reign.34.t
	desc = zin_reign.34.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_thirty_days
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	trigger = {
		zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
		OR = {
			AND = {
				check_variable = {
					var = zin_aenor_camp_court
					value = 30
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = zin_aenor_camp_faithful
					value = 30
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			AND = {
				check_variable = {
					var = zin_aenor_camp_court
					value = 30
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = zin_aenor_camp_dominions
					value = 30
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			AND = {
				check_variable = {
					var = zin_aenor_camp_court
					value = 30
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = zin_aenor_camp_host
					value = 30
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			AND = {
				check_variable = {
					var = zin_aenor_camp_faithful
					value = 30
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}

					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}

					compare = greater_than_or_equals

				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
				original_tag = SEL
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -1.429
				zin_rules_is_historical = no
				zin_rules_is_free = no
				check_variable = { global.zin_path_divergence < 50 }
				original_tag = SEL
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 0.714
				zin_rules_is_historical = no
				zin_rules_is_free = no
				check_variable = { global.zin_path_divergence > 49.999 }
				original_tag = SEL
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
		zin_aenor_add_concord_loyalty = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_concord_loyalty < 25 }
			}
			zin_aenor_secede_dominion = yes
		}
	}
}
